quotes.text: Had an incredible experience with Go Fish Charters! (Ben) The Captain made the experience worth it alone. Friendly, Experienced and Knowledgeable. We got some RBA (Rod Bending Action)!
Ben showed us an excellent day He is a very personable captain that really enjoys his work. Highly recommend and when we return will charter with him again
Such a great time and we caught a ton of fish! Ben was super patient, instructive and encouraging. Couldn't ask for a better excursion.
